summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only ("attempt to write a readonly database"). POST /orders and the ledger sync both fail on writes. The underlying cause (file permissions, a read-only volume remount, or disk/storage fault) is unknown.
recommended: A human or infra owner should restore write access to the database: check the file or volume permissions, any read-only remount, disk full or filesystem errors, and the storage layer.
After write access is back, run check_invariants and confirm the sync resumes.
Check ledger and order consistency with check_data_integrity, and reprocess or repair if needed.
Have clients retry the orders that got a 500 response, since those were never created.
Make the health check test a DB write.
